verdict.rationale: Runpod docs describe exposing ports via 'web proxy for exposed web services' on Pods (runpod-docs-14/45) alongside SSH/JupyterLab/VS Code access, and Instant Clusters provide 'high-performance networking for distributed workloads' enabling multi-node/private networking between instances (runpod-docs-4/17/37/48). Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of port-exposure and inter-instance private networking, and more detail on how private networking is configured/secured beyond the Instant Clusters feature blurb.
